description:
Buy credits via Bitcoin Lightning.

Creates a Lightning invoice. Pay it with any Lightning wallet,
then call check_payment to confirm. Proof of npub ownership is
required so credits land in the correct ledger.

Free — no credits required to call.

dpop_token.description:
Proof that the caller holds npub: the grant envelope from
receive_npub_proof, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed
by npub whose `u` tag is this tool's name.

npub.description: The Nostr public key (npub1...) the credits will fund.

name: taxsort_purchase_credits
title: Buy credits
